description: Structured eval definitions for the SageMaker Endpoint Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across hosting modes (real-time with auto-scaling, A/B testing, serverless inference, asynchronous inference) and missing-prerequisite branches. Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Real-time endpoint with auto-scaling, data capture, and model monitoring
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — all checklist items verified, real-time endpoint with 2-instance HA, auto-scaling, data capture, model monitor
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy a SageMaker real-time inference endpoint in us-east-1 for a recommendation model. Endpoint name "prod-recommendation". Model artifact at s3://ml-artifacts/models/rec/model.tar.gz. Container image 763104351884.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/pytorch-inference:2.1.0-cpu-py310. Execution role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/SageMakerExecutionRole. Instance type ml.c5.xlarge, initial count 2 for HA. Auto-scaling on InvocationsPerInstance with target 14, min 2, max 8. Data capture enabled at 20% sampling to s3://sagemaker-captures-prod/rec/. Data quality model monitor on hourly schedule. KMS encryption with key alias/prod-sagemaker-key. VPC subnets subnet-aaa, subnet-bbb, security group sg-xxx. Tags: Environment=production, Workload=recommendation. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ENDPOINT: prod-recommendation
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Model: prod-recommendation-model (S3: s3://ml-artifacts/models/rec/model.tar.gz)
  [✓] Container image: 763104351884.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/pytorch-inference:2.1.0-cpu-py310
  [✓] Execution role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/SageMakerExecutionRole
  [✓] Hosting mode: real-time
  [✓] Instance type: ml.c5.xlarge (CPU, tabular recommendation)
  [✓] Initial instance count: 2 (HA across 2 AZs)
  [✓] Variant: AllTraffic
  [✓] Encryption: KMS alias/prod-sagemaker-key
  [✓] Auto-scaling: target=InvocationsPerInstance, TargetValue=14, min=2, max=8
  [✓] Data capture: Enabled, sampling=20%, destination=s3://sagemaker-captures-prod/rec/
  [✓] Model monitor: data quality schedule=hourly
  [✓] VPC config: subnet-aaa, subnet-bbb, sg-xxx
  [✓] Tags: Environment=production, Workload=recommendation
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws sagemaker describe-endpoint --endpoint-name prod-recommendation
  aws sagemaker describe-endpoint-config --endpoint-config-name prod-recommendation-config
  aws sagemaker describe-model --model-name prod-recommendation-model
  aws application-autoscaling describe-scaling-policies --service-namespace sagemaker --resource-id endpoint/prod-recommendation/variant/AllTraffic
  aws s3 ls s3://sagemaker-captures-prod/rec/prod-recommendation/AllTraffic/

eval_cases.name: A/B testing endpoint with two variants at 90/10 traffic split
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — A/B testing with two variants, same instance type, weighted traffic
eval_cases.prompt: Set up A/B testing on a SageMaker endpoint "ab-churn-endpoint" in us-east-1. Two models: "churn-model-v1" (artifact s3://ml/churn-v1/model.tar.gz) and "churn-model-v2" (artifact s3://ml/churn-v2/model.tar.gz). Both use the same container image 763104351884.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/xgboost-inference:1.7-1. Execution role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/SageMakerExecutionRole. Instance type ml.c5.xlarge, 2 instances each. Traffic split 90% to variantA (v1), 10% to variantB (v2). Data capture enabled at 50% sampling. KMS encryption with alias/sagemaker-key. Tags: Environment=staging, Workload=churn-ab-test. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ENDPOINT: ab-churn-endpoint
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Model: churn-model-v1 (S3: s3://ml/churn-v1/model.tar.gz)
  [✓] Model: churn-model-v2 (S3: s3://ml/churn-v2/model.tar.gz)
  [✓] Container image: 763104351884.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/xgboost-inference:1.7-1
  [✓] Hosting mode: real-time (A/B testing)
  [✓] Instance type: ml.c5.xlarge (same for both variants — avoids confounding)
  [✓] Variant A: churn-model-v1, InitialInstanceCount=2, InitialVariantWeight=9 (90%)
  [✓] Variant B: churn-model-v2, InitialInstanceCount=2, InitialVariantWeight=1 (10%)
  [✓] Data capture: Enabled, sampling=50%
  [✓] Encryption: KMS alias/sagemaker-key
  [✓] Tags: Environment=staging, Workload=churn-ab-test
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws sagemaker describe-endpoint --endpoint-name ab-churn-endpoint
  aws sagemaker describe-endpoint-config --endpoint-config-name ab-churn-config

eval_cases.name: Serverless Inference endpoint for intermittent text classification
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — serverless with ProvisionedConcurrency=1, scale-to-zero when idle
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy a SageMaker Serverless Inference endpoint in us-east-1 for a text classification model. Endpoint name "serverless-classifier". Model artifact at s3://ml-artifacts/classifier/model.tar.gz. Container image 763104351884.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/pytorch-inference:2.1.0-cpu-py310. Execution role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/SageMakerExecutionRole. Traffic is intermittent — a few requests per hour. Serverless config: MemorySizeInMB 2048, MaxConcurrency 10, ProvisionedConcurrency 1 for minimal warm capacity. KMS encryption with alias/sagemaker-key. Tags: Environment=production, Workload=text-classification. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ENDPOINT: serverless-classifier
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Model: serverless-classifier-model (S3: s3://ml-artifacts/classifier/model.tar.gz)
  [✓] Container image: 763104351884.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/pytorch-inference:2.1.0-cpu-py310
  [✓] Execution role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/SageMakerExecutionRole
  [✓] Hosting mode: serverless
  [✓] Serverless config: MemorySizeInMB=2048, MaxConcurrency=10, ProvisionedConcurrency=1
  [✓] Auto-scaling: built-in (scale-to-zero when idle)
  [✓] Encryption: KMS alias/sagemaker-key
  [✓] Tags: Environment=production, Workload=text-classification
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws sagemaker describe-endpoint --endpoint-name serverless-classifier
  aws sagemaker describe-endpoint-config --endpoint-config-name serverless-classifier-config

eval_cases.name: Asynchronous Inference endpoint for large computer vision payloads
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — async with S3 queueing, SNS notification, scale-to-zero
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy a SageMaker Asynchronous Inference endpoint in us-east-1 for a computer vision model that processes large images. Endpoint name "async-vision". Model artifact at s3://ml-artifacts/vision/model.tar.gz. Container image 763104351884.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/pytorch-inference:2.1.0-gpu-py310. Execution role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/SageMakerExecutionRole. Instance type ml.g5.xlarge, initial count 1 (scale to 0 when idle). Async output to s3://async-output/vision/ with SNS success topic arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:vision-success and error topic arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:vision-error. Auto-scaling on ApproximateBacklogSizePerInstance with target 5, min 0, max 4. KMS encryption with alias/sagemaker-key. Tags: Environment=production, Workload=computer-vision-async. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ENDPOINT: async-vision
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Model: async-vision-model (S3: s3://ml-artifacts/vision/model.tar.gz)
  [✓] Container image: 763104351884.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/pytorch-inference:2.1.0-gpu-py310
  [✓] Hosting mode: asynchronous
  [✓] Instance type: ml.g5.xlarge (GPU for computer vision)
  [✓] Initial instance count: 1 (scale to 0 when idle)
  [✓] Async output: s3://async-output/vision/, SNS success=arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:vision-success, error=arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:vision-error
  [✓] Auto-scaling: target=ApproximateBacklogSizePerInstance, TargetValue=5, min=0, max=4
  [✓] Encryption: KMS alias/sagemaker-key
  [✓] Tags: Environment=production, Workload=computer-vision-async
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws sagemaker describe-endpoint --endpoint-name async-vision
  aws sagemaker describe-endpoint-config --endpoint-config-name async-vision-config
  aws application-autoscaling describe-scaling-policies --service-namespace sagemaker --resource-id endpoint/async-vision/variant/AllTraffic

eval_cases.name: Operator missing S3 model artifact and execution role — prerequisites missing
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — S3 model artifact and execution role both unprovided
eval_cases.prompt: Help me create a SageMaker endpoint called "fraud-detection" in us-east-1. I have a trained model locally but haven't uploaded it to S3 yet. I also haven't set up a SageMaker execution role. I want a real-time endpoint on ml.c5.xlarge with 2 instances. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ENDPOINT: fraud-detection
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] S3 model artifact: NOT provided — model.tar.gz must be uploaded to S3 before create-model
  [✗] Execution role: NOT provided — SageMaker execution role with sagemaker.amazonaws.com trust + S3 read + ECR pull required
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws s3 ls s3://  (identify target bucket)
  aws iam list-roles --query 'Roles[?contains(RoleName, `SageMaker`)]'
